F16H.ja:
伝動装置｛（車両の相対する側にある，地面と係合する要素を弁別的に駆動することにより自動車を操向するもの　Ｂ６２Ｄ１１／０２）｝

注

１．機械的伝動装置を含む組み合わせはグループＦ１６Ｈ１／００～Ｆ１６Ｈ３５／００に分類されていない限りグループＦ１６Ｈ３７／００またはＦ１６Ｈ４７／００に分類する
２．このサブクラスにおいては，剛結合された部材は単一部材とみなす
３．このサブクラスにおいては，下記の用語または表現は以下に示す意味で用いる；
―　歯車伝動装置はウォーム伝動装置および歯または歯に相当するものを備えた少なくとも１つの車または扇形車を含む他の伝動装置を含み，チェーンや歯付きベルトによる伝動装置は摩擦伝動装置で取り扱うので除く；
―　運動の伝達はエネルギを伝達することを含むとともに，入，出力運動が，たとえば速度，方向または大きさにおいて相違していようとも，同種であることを意味する；
―　回転は回転が無限に続き得ることを意味する；
―　振動は伝動装置の構造によって規制される範囲で，一回転以上をも含めて，軸のまわりを運動し，その運動は伝動装置の連続運転中，交互に前後することを意味する；
―　往復運動は本質的に直線の運動を意味し，その運動は伝動装置の連続運転中，交互に前後することを意味する；
―　逆転するまたは逆転は一方向の入力運動から生じる出力運動が２つの反対方向のどちらかに随意に切換え得ることを意味する；
―　中心歯車はその軸が伝動装置の主軸あるすべての歯車を含む

F16H.en:
GEARING

NOTE

Combinations including mechanical gearings are classified in groups F16H37/00 or F16H47/00, unless they are provided for in groups F16H1/00 - F16H35/00.
In this subclass, sets of rigidly-connected members are regarded as single members.
In this subclass, the following terms or expressions are used with the meanings indicated:
"toothed gearing" includes worm gearing and other gearing involving at least one wheel or sector provided with teeth or the equivalent, EXCEPT gearing with chains or toothed belts, which is treated as friction gearing;
"conveying motion" includes transmitting energy, and means that the applied and resultant motions are of the same kind, though they may differ in, e.g. speed, direction extent:
"rotary" implies that the motion may continue indefinitely;
"oscillating" means moving about an axis to an extent which is limited by the construction of the gearing, and which may exceed one revolution, the movement being alternately forwards and backwards during continued operation of the gearing;
"reciprocating" means moving substantially in a straight line, the movement being alternately forwards and backwards during continued operation of the gearing;
"reversing" or "reversal" means that an applied movement in one direction may produce a resultant movement in either of two opposed directions at will;
"central gears" includes any gears whose axis is the main axis of the gearing.

NOTE

Guide to the use of this subsection (classes F01-F04)
The following notes are meant to assist in the use of this part of the classification scheme.
In this subsection, subclasses or groups designating "engines" or "pumps" cover methods of operating the same, unless otherwise specifically provided for.
In this subsection, the following terms or expressions are used with the meanings indicated:
"engine" means a device for continuously converting fluid energy into mechanical power. Thus, this term includes, for example, steam piston engines or steam turbines, per se, or internal-combustion piston engines, but it excludes single-stroke devices. "Engine" also includes the fluid-motive portion of a meter unless such portion is particularly adapted for use in a meter;
"pump" means a device for continuously raising, forcing, compressing, or exhausting fluid by mechanical or other means.
Thus, this term includes fans or blowers;
"machine" means a device which could equally be an engine and a pump, and not a device which is restricted to an engine or one which is restricted to a pump;

"positive displacement" means the way the energy of a working fluid is transformed into mechanical energy, in which variations of volume created by the working fluid in a working chamber produce equivalent displacements of the mechanical member transmitting the energy, the dynamic effect of the fluid being of minor importance, and vice versa;

"non-positive displacement" means the way the energy of a working fluid is transformed into mechanical energy, by transformation of the energy of the working fluid into kinetic energy, and vice versa;

"oscillating-piston machine" means a positive-displacement machine in which a fluid-engaging work-transmitting member oscillates. This definition applies also to engines and pumps;

"rotary-piston machine" means a positive-displacement machine in which a fluid-engaging work-transmitting member rotates about a fixed axis or about an axis moving along a circular or similar orbit. This definition applies also to engines and pumps;

"rotary piston" means the work-transmitting member of a rotary-piston machine and may be of any suitable form, e.g., like a toothed gear;

"cooperating members" means the "oscillating piston" or "rotary piston" and another member, e.g., the working-chamber wall, which assists in the driving or pumping action;

"movement of the co-operating members" is to be interpreted as relative, so that one of the "co-operating members" may be stationary, even though reference may be made to its rotational axis, or both may move;
"teeth or tooth equivalents" include lobes, projections or abutments;

"internal-axis type" means that the rotational axes of the inner and outer co-operating members remain at all times within the outer member, e.g., in a similar manner to that of a pinion meshing with the internal teeth of a ring gear;

"free piston" means a piston of which the length of stroke is not defined by any member driven thereby;

cylinders" means positive-displacement working chambers in general. Thus, this term is not restricted to cylinders of circular cross-section;

main shaft" means the shaft which converts reciprocating piston motion into rotary motion or vice versa;

"plant" means an engine together with such additional apparatus as is necessary to run the engine. For example, a steam engine plant includes a steam engine and means for generating the steam;

"working fluid" means the driven fluid in a pump or the driving fluid in an engine. The working fluid can be in a compressible, gaseous state, called elastic fluid, e.g. steam; in a liquid state; or in a state where there is coexistence of an elastic fluid and liquid phase.
"steam" includes condensable vapours in general, and "special vapour" is used when steam is excluded;

"reaction type" as applied to non-positive-displacement machines or engines means machines or engines in which pressure/velocity transformation takes place wholly or partly in the rotor. Machines or engines with no, or only slight, pressure/velocity transformation in the rotor are called "impulse type".
In this subsection:
cyclically operating valves, lubricating, gas-flow silencers or exhaust apparatus, or cooling are classified in subclasses F01L, F01M, F01N, F01P irrespective of their stated application, unless their classifying features are peculiar to their application, in which case they are classified only in the relevant subclass of classes F01- F04;

lubricating, gas-flow silencers or exhaust apparatus, or cooling of machines or engines are classified in subclasses F01M, F01N, F01P except for those peculiar to steam engines which are classified in subclass F01B.
For use of this subsection with a good understanding, it is essential to remember, so far as subclasses F01B, F01C, F01D, F03B, and F04B, F04C, F04D, which form its skeleton, are concerned:
the principle which resides in their elaboration
the classifying characteristics which they call for, and
their complementarity
Principle
This concerns essentially the subclasses listed above. Other subclasses, notably those of class F02, which cover better-defined matter, are not considered here.

Each subclass covers fundamentally a genus of apparatus (engine or pump) and by extension covers equally "machines" of the same kind. Two different subjects, one having a more general character than the other, are thus covered by the same subclass.

Subclasses F01B, F03B, F04B, beyond the two subjects which they cover, have further a character of generality in relation to other subclasses concerning the different species of apparatus in the genus concerned.

This generality applies as well for the two subjects dealt with, without these always being in relation to the same subclasses.

Thus, subclass F03B, in its part dealing with "machines", should be considered as being the general class relating to subclasses F04B, F04C, and in its part dealing with "engines" as being general in relation to subclass F03C.

Characteristics
The principal classifying characteristic of the subclass is that of genera of apparatus, of which there are three possible:
Machines; engines; pumps.
As stated above, "machines" are always associated with one of the other two genera.These main genera are subdivided according to the general principles of operation of the apparatus:
Positive displacement; non-positive displacement.
The positive displacement apparatus are further subdivided according to the ways of putting into effect the principle of operation, that is, to the kind of apparatus:
Simple reciprocating piston; rotary or oscillating piston; other kind.
Another classifying characteristic is that of the working fluid, in respect of which three kinds of apparatus are possible, namely:
Liquid and elastic fluid; elastic fluid; liquid.
Complementarity
This resides in association of pairs of the subclasses listed above, according to the characteristics under consideration in respect of kind of apparatus or working fluid.

F16H2061/1264.en: {Hydraulic parts of the controller, e.g. a sticking valve or clogged channel}

F16H2061/1268.ja: ｛コントローラの電気部品であるもの，例．欠陥のあるソレノイド、配線またはマイクロプロセッサ｝
F16H2061/1268.en: {Electric parts of the controller, e.g. a defect solenoid, wiring or microprocessor}

F16H2061/1272.ja: ｛故障部品が最終出力機構の部品であるもの，例．シフトロッドまたはフォーク｝

F16H2061/1276.ja: ｛故障部品が摩擦部材であるもの，例．クラッチまたはブレーキ｝
F16H2061/1276.en: {the failing part is a friction device, e.g. clutches or brakes}

F16H2061/1284.ja: ｛故障部品がセンサーであるもの｝

F16H2061/1288.ja: ｛故障部品がアクチュエータであるもの｝

F16H2061/1292.ja: ｛故障部品が電源であるもの，例．電源｝
F16H2061/1292.en: {the failing part is the power supply, e.g. the electric power supply}

F16H2061/1296.ja: ｛故障部品がトランスミッションの一部を形成する電気機械であるもの｝
F16H2061/1296.en: {the failing part is an electric machine forming part of the transmission}

F16H61/14.ja: トルクコンバータのロックアップクラッチの制御
F16H61/14.en: Control of torque converter lock-up clutches

F16H61/141.ja: ｛遠心力により作動されるだけの手段を使用するもの｝
F16H61/141.en: {using means only actuated by centrifugal force}

F16H61/142.ja: ｛手段が液圧制御弁であるもの｝

F16H61/143.ja: ｛電気信号を使用することによるもの｝

F16H2061/145.ja: ｛スリップを制御するもの，例．目標スリップに近づけるもの｝
F16H2061/145.en: {for controlling slip, e.g. approaching target slip value}

F16H2061/147.ja: ｛エンジンブレーキ中のもの，例．トルクの方向が変更されたときに歯車の衝撃を減衰させるもの｝
F16H2061/147.en: {during engine braking, e.g. to attenuate gear clunk when torque direction is changed}

F16H61/148.ja: ｛機械的手段を使用するもの（Ｆ１６Ｈ６１／１４１が優先）｝

F16H61/16.ja: 禁止するもの　｛または開始するもの｝好ましくない状態中でのシフト，｛例．高車速での前進を逆転するシフトを防ぐもの，エンジンの過速度を防ぐもの｝（Ｆ１６Ｈ６１／１８が優先）
F16H61/16.en: Inhibiting  {or initiating}  shift during unfavourable conditions  {, e.g. preventing forward-reverse shift at high vehicle speed, preventing engine overspeed}   (F16H61/18 takes precedence)

F16H2061/161.ja: ｛シフトの実現可能性を確認することによるもの，すなわち要求されたシフトが正常に完了することができるかを判断し、ポストシフト値は許容範囲内にある｝
F16H2061/161.en: {by checking feasibility of shifts, i.e. determine if requested shift can be successfully completed and post shift values are in an acceptable range}

F16H2061/163.ja: ｛好ましくない条件でギヤシフトを遅延させるためにギヤを保持するもの，例．コーナリング中｝
F16H2061/163.en: {Holding the gear for delaying gear shifts under unfavorable conditions, e.g. during cornering}

F16H2061/165.ja: ｛車速が安全なシフトに対して高すぎる場合にリバースギヤシフトを禁止するもの｝
F16H2061/165.en: {Preventing reverse gear shifts if vehicle speed is too high for safe shifting}

F16H2061/166.ja: ｛エンストまたはエンジン過回転を防止するためにシフトを禁止するまたは開始するもの｝
F16H2061/166.en: {Preventing or initiating shifts for preventing stall or overspeed of engine}

F16H2061/168.ja: ｛安全上の理由から強制的にニュートラルにシフトするもの，例．トランスミッションの故障や非常ブレーキの作動時｝
F16H2061/168.en: {Forced shifts into neutral for safety reasons, e.g. in case of transmission failure or emergency braking}

F16H61/18.ja: 意図的でないまたは安全でないシフトを防ぐもの，　｛例．トップギヤからバックギヤへの手動のギヤシフトを防ぐものまたはもし主クラッチが解放されていないなら手動のギヤシフトを防ぐもの｝
F16H61/18.en: Preventing unintentional or unsafe shift {, e.g. preventing manual shift from highest gear to reverse gear}

F16H2061/185.ja: ｛手段，例．意図的でないリバースギヤへのシフトを防ぐための留め具やインターロック｝
F16H2061/185.en: {Means, e.g. catches or interlocks, for preventing unintended shift into reverse gear}

F16H61/20.ja: 伝動装置のクリープを防ぐもの；　｛停車中の伝動装置の制御，例．ニュートラルモードにおけるもの｝
F16H61/20.en: Preventing gear creeping {; Transmission control during standstill, e.g. hill hold control}

F16H2061/202.ja: ｛低速走行のためのクリープ制御，例．クラッチの滑りを制御することによるもの｝
F16H2061/202.en: {Active creep control for slow driving, e.g. by controlling clutch slip}

F16H2061/205.ja: ｛ヒルホールド制御，例．車両を静止状態に保つためにトルクコンバータや摩擦要素の僅かな係合を用いるもの｝
F16H2061/205.en: {Hill hold control, e.g. with torque converter or a friction device slightly engaged to keep vehicle stationary}

F16H2061/207.ja: ｛ニュートラル制御によるもの｝

F16H61/21.ja: エンジンブレーキの制御を与えるもの

F16H2061/213.ja: ｛非常ブレーキのためのもの，例．非常時にブレーキ力を増大させるためのもの｝
F16H2061/213.en: {for emergency braking, e.g. for increasing brake power in emergency situations}

F16H2061/216.ja: ｛排気ブレーキを用いることによるもの｝

F16H61/22.ja: ロッキング（Ｆ１６Ｈ６３／３４が優先；｛不正使用防止のための車両装備、例．イグニッションキー，歯車箱またはシフトレバーと連動するものＢ６０Ｒ２５／０２Ｂ６Ｂ(ＥＣＬＡ)｝）
F16H61/22.en: Locking {of the control input devices}(constructional features of locking or disabling mechanisms F16H63/34)

F16H2061/223.ja: ｛電気的ギヤシフトロック，すなわちブレーキが作動されていない場合に電気的手段によりレバーをＰまはたＮにロックするもの；キーインターロック，すなわちレバーがＰにない場合にキーをロックするもの｝
F16H2061/223.en: {Electrical gear shift lock, e.g. locking of lever in park or neutral position by electric means if brake is not applied; Key interlock, i.e. locking the key if lever is not in park position}

F16H2061/226.ja: ｛緊急時にシフトレバーのロック手段を手動で解除するもの，例．故障の場合に車両の牽引を可能にするためのもの（パーキングロックＦ１６Ｈ６３／３４９１）｝
F16H2061/226.en: {Manual distress release of the locking means for shift levers, e.g. to allow towing of vehicle in case of breakdown}

F16H61/24.ja: 感覚を与えるもの，例．選択を可能にすること
F16H61/24.en: Providing feel, e.g. to enable selection

F16H2061/241.ja: ｛感覚を与えたりシフトゲートをシミュレートするアクチュエータ，すなわちフィードバックのための反力を提供するために積極的な力の発生を用いるもの｝
F16H2061/241.en: {Actuators providing feel or simulating a shift gate, i.e. with active force generation for providing counter forces for feed back}

F16H2061/242.ja: ｛セレクトアンドシフト時の機械的シフトゲートまたは類似のガイド手段｝
F16H2061/242.en: {Mechanical shift gates or similar guiding means during selection and shifting}

F16H2061/243.ja: ｛案内し感覚を与えるためのカムや戻り止めの配列｝
F16H2061/243.en: {Cams or detent arrays for guiding and providing feel}

F16H2061/245.ja: ｛力の閾値を生成するためのランプの輪郭，例．逆方向パスのための追加の抵抗を発生させるためのカムやプッシャー｝
F16H2061/245.en: {Ramp contours for generating force threshold, e.g. cams or pushers for generating additional resistance for a reverse path}

F16H2061/246.ja: ｛感覚を向上させるためにシフトリンケージに質量または重量を追加するもの｝
F16H2061/246.en: {Additional mass or weight on shift linkage for improving feel}

F16H2061/247.ja: ｛レンジセレクターの戻り止め｝

F16H2061/248.ja: ｛選択またはシフトフィードバックを与えるために音声信号を伴うもの｝
F16H2061/248.en: {with audible signals for providing selection or shift feed back}

F16H61/26.ja:
最終作動機構のための運動の発生あるいは伝達

選択装置のみから成る運動の発生または伝達は，グループＦ１６Ｈ５９／００に分類される
最終出力機構の一部分の場合，運動の発生または伝達は，グループＦ１６Ｈ６３／００に分類される

Generation or transmission of movements for final actuating mechanisms

The generation or transmission of movements comprising only the selector apparatus, is classified in group F16H59/00.
The generation or transmission of movements, when part of the final output mechanisms, is classified in group F16H63/00.

F16H61/28.en: with at least one movement of the final actuating mechanism being caused by a non-mechanical force, e.g. power-assisted

F16H61/2807.ja: ｛電気制御信号を使用するもの，例．電気油圧制御（Ｆ１６Ｈ６１／３０，Ｆ１６Ｈ６１／３２が優先；シフト信号を生成する方法　Ｆ１６Ｈ６１／０２０２）｝
F16H61/2807.en: {using electric control signals for shift actuators, e.g. electro-hydraulic control therefor  (F16H61/30, F16H61/32 take precedence)}

F16H61/2815.ja: ｛リレーとスイッチのみを使用する制御装置をもつもの｝
F16H61/2815.en: {with a control using only relays and switches}

F16H2061/2823.ja: アクチュエータの力の方向，すなわち，アクチュエータの位置に依存する制御力または運動に特徴を有する制御，例．ギアクラッチの同期および係合の力を適合させるもの
F16H2061/2823.en: {Controlling actuator force way characteristic, i.e. controlling force or movement depending on the actuator position, e.g. for adapting force to synchronisation and engagement of gear clutch}

F16H2061/283.ja: 作動位置の調整または校正，例．ニュートラルポジション
F16H2061/283.en: {Adjustment or calibration of actuator positions, e.g. neutral position}

F16H2061/2838.ja: 選択とシフト運動のための単一の駆動モータ，すなわち，両方の運動を発生させるための一つのモータ装置
F16H2061/2838.en: {Arrangements with single drive motor for selecting and shifting movements, i.e. one motor used for generating both movements}

F16H2061/2846.ja: ギア比をスキップさせるジャンプシフトを可能とするためのアクチュエータ装置
F16H2061/2846.en: {Arrangements of actuators for enabling jump shifting for skipping of gear ratios}

F16H2061/2892.ja: その他の伝動装置，例．ウオームギヤ，回転運動を出力機構に伝達するもの
F16H2061/2892.en: {other gears, e.g. worm gears, for transmitting rotary motion to the output mechanism}

F16H61/30.ja: そのための液圧的なもの｛または空圧的なもの｝モータ｛または関連する流体制御手段｝
F16H61/30.en: Hydraulic {or pneumatic} motors {or related fluid control means} therefor

F16H2061/301.ja: パワーアシストするもの，すなわち，追従動作をもつサーボ機構
F16H2061/301.en: {for power assistance, i.e. servos with follow up action}

F16H2061/304.en: {using telemotors, i.e. systems with master cylinder and linked shift actuator without external pressure source}

F16H2061/305.ja: 液体をサーボモータに供給するアキュムレータ，またはその制御（ライン圧のためのアキュムレータ　Ｒ１６Ｈ６１／００Ｋ４（ＥＣＬＡ））
F16H2061/305.en: {Accumulators for fluid supply to the servo motors, or control thereof}

F16H2061/307.ja: 所定の３つの位置を備えたアクチュエータ，すなわち，３位置サーボ機構
F16H2061/307.en: {Actuators with three or more defined positions, e.g. three position servos}

F16H2061/308.ja: 規格化された液体シフトユニット，すなわち，伝動装置のケーシングへの搭載に適応する，選択およびシフト運動のために予選択されたアクチュエータユニット
F16H2061/308.en: {Modular hydraulic shift units, i.e. preassembled actuator units for select and shift movements adapted for being mounted on transmission casing}

F16H61/32.ja: そのための電動モータ｛アクチュエータまたは関連する電気制御手段｝
F16H61/32.en: Electric motors  {, actuators or related electrical control means}  therefor

F16H2061/323.ja: パワーアシストするもの，すなわち，追従動作をもつサーボ機構
F16H2061/323.en: {for power assistance, i.e. servos with follow up action}

F16H2061/326.ja: 範囲選択のためのアクチュエータ，すなわち，伝動装置のレンジセレクターまたは手動レンジ弁を制御するためのアクチュエータ
F16H2061/326.en: {Actuators for range selection, i.e. actuators for controlling the range selector or the manual range valve in the transmission}

F16H61/34.ja: 一つが予選択運動のためのものであり，一つがシフト運動のためのものである二つの機構を含むもの（Ｆ１６Ｈ６１／３６が優先）

F16H61/36.en: with at least one movement being transmitted by a cable

F16H61/38.ja: 流体伝動装置のみの制御

F16H61/40.ja: 静圧形（伝動装置の変形を含むものＦ１６Ｈ３９／０２，Ｆ１６Ｈ３９／０４）

F16H61/4017.ja: 高圧回路の制御，例．リリーフ弁による超過油圧の防止
F16H61/4017.en: Control of high pressure, e.g. avoiding excess pressure by a relief valve

F16H61/4043.ja: 高圧回路と低圧回路をバイパスする弁に関連する制御

F16H61/4052.ja: 弁が可変絞り機能を有するもの，例．オリフィス弁
F16H61/4052.en: by using a variable restriction, e.g. an orifice valve

F16H61/4061.ja: 方向切換弁に関連する制御，例．給水導管を横断する切換弁（斜板を用いて前後進の切換を行うもの６１／４３８）
F16H61/4061.en: Control related to directional control valves, e.g. change-over valves, for crossing the feeding conduits

F16H61/4069.ja: 中立制御に関連する弁，例．シャットオフ弁（斜板の中立位置への手段は、６１／４３９）
F16H61/4069.en: Valves related to the control of neutral, e.g. shut off valves

F16H61/4078.ja: 油圧回路と外部または補機との流体の交換
F16H61/4078.en: Fluid exchange between hydrostatic circuits and external sources or consumers

F16H61/4096.ja: アキュムレータを用いたもの

F16H61/4104.ja: フラッシング，例．フラッシング弁や排出手段への接続によるもの
F16H61/4104.en: Flushing, e.g. by using flushing valves or by connection to exhaust

F16H61/4131.ja: タンクからの吸引による流体の交換，例．オイルパン
F16H61/4131.en: Fluid exchange by aspiration from reservoirs, e.g. sump

F16H61/4139.ja: 補充または清掃用のポンプ，例．補充用チャージポンプ
F16H61/4139.en: Replenishing or scavenging pumps, e.g. auxiliary charge pumps

F16H61/4157.ja: 制動装置の制御，例．モータがポンプとして作動するときのポンプのオーバーラン防止
F16H61/4157.en: Control of braking, e.g. preventing pump over-speeding when motor acts as a pump

F16H61/4165.ja: 冷却または潤滑の制御

F16H61/4174.ja: 通気孔の制御，例．捕捉した空気の除去
F16H61/4174.en: Control of venting, e.g. removing trapped air

F16H61/4183.ja: 振動または騒音の防止または減少，例．キャビテーション防止
F16H61/4183.en: Preventing or reducing vibrations or noise, e.g. avoiding cavitations

F16H61/4192.ja: 機能不調または機能不調の可能性があることを検知するもの，例．フェイルセーフ
F16H61/4192.en: Detecting malfunction or potential malfunction, e.g. fail safe

F16H61/42.ja: 可変出力または容量を備えているポンプまたはモータの調整装置を含むもの｛（Ｆ１６Ｈ６１／４６が優先）｝
F16H61/42.en: involving adjustment of a pump or motor with adjustable output or capacity

F16H61/421.ja: 電気水力学的制御手段を用いたモータ容量の制御，例．ソレノイド弁を用いたもの
F16H61/421.en: Motor capacity control by electro-hydraulic control means, e.g. using solenoid valves

F16H61/423.ja: 油圧制御手段を用いたモータ容量の制御
F16H61/423.en: Motor capacity control by fluid pressure control means

F16H61/425.ja: 電気アクチュエータを用いたモータ容量の制御

F16H61/427.ja: 機械的な制御手段を用いたモータ容量の制御，例．レバーやペダルを用いたもの
F16H61/427.en: Motor capacity control by mechanical control means, e.g. by levers or pedals

F16H61/431.ja: 電気水力学的制御手段を用いたポンプ容量の制御，例．ソレノイド弁を用いたもの
F16H61/431.en: Pump capacity control by electro-hydraulic control means, e.g. using solenoid valves

F16H61/433.ja: 油圧制御手段を用いたポンプ容量の制御
F16H61/433.en: Pump capacity control by fluid pressure control means

F16H61/435.ja: 電気アクチュエータを用いたポンプ容量の制御
F16H61/435.en: Pump capacity control by electric actuators

F16H61/437.ja: 機械的な制御手段を用いたポンプ容量の制御，例．レバーやペダルを用いたもの
F16H61/437.en: Pump capacity control by mechanical control means, e.g. by levers or pedals

F16H61/438.ja: 前後進の切換の制御，例．斜板の制御（方向切換弁を用いたものは、６１／４０６１）
F16H61/438.en: Control of forward-reverse switching, e.g. control of the swash plate causing discharge in two directions

F16H61/439.ja: 中立位置の制御，例．斜板の中立位置への手段（中立弁やシャットオフ弁を用いたものは、６１／４０６９）
F16H61/439.en: Control of the neutral position, e.g. by zero tilt rotation holding means

F16H61/44.ja: 運転中のポンプまたはモータユニットの数の変更によるもの
F16H61/44.en: with more than one pump or motor in operation

F16H61/444.ja: 運転中のポンプまたはモータユニットの数の変更によるもの
F16H61/444.en: by changing the number of pump or motor units in operation

F16H61/448.ja: タンデムポンプまたはモータのために回路を制御するもの
F16H61/448.en: Control circuits for tandem pumps or motors

F16H61/452.ja: 複数のポンプまたはモータを選択的に制御したもの，例．直列または並列の切換
F16H61/452.en: Selectively controlling multiple pumps or motors, e.g. switching between series or parallel

F16H61/456.ja: 複数のポンプ間またはモータ間におけるトルクまたは速度のバランスを制御したもの（静圧形差動装置４８／１８）
F16H61/456.en: Control of the balance of torque or speed between pumps or motors

F16H61/46.ja: 出力要求による自動調整（サーボモータＧ０５Ｂ）
F16H61/46.en: Automatic regulation in accordance with output requirements

F16H61/461.ja: ｛主ポンプまたはモータの出力容量の変化を含まないもの｝
F16H61/461.en: {not involving a variation of the output capacity of the main pumps or motors}
